title: Everyday Phrases — Getting Internet Installed
scene_zh: 安裝寬頻 · 情境對話
title_quote: My internet is down again today.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】📶 實用安裝寬頻必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Getting Internet Installed
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的「安裝寬頻」情境對話：從致電電信公司挑選套餐資費、預約師傅上門時段與居家準備、師傅進家佈線設定路由器，到最後測速簽單、設備歸還與帳單諮詢，全片 400 句生活化英文短句（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features 400 practical 'Getting Internet Installed' phrase pairs — calling the provider to compare plans, booking the installer's visit, running cables and setting up the router, then speed tests, signatures and billing questions (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My internet is down again today.
dialogue.zh: 我的網路今天又斷線了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Again? That's so frustrating!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think we need faster service.
dialogue.zh: 我想我們需要更快的網路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should we call the phone company?
dialogue.zh: 我們該打給電信公司嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me find their number online.
dialogue.zh: 我上網找他們的客服電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, please call them now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The website has a contact page.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is there a customer service line?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it's the number at the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪts ðə ˈnʌmbər æt ðə tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 有啊，號碼就在頁面最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, dial it for me please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'm calling right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it on speaker, all right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello? I'd like new internet service.
dialogue.zh: 喂？我想申請新的網路服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell them we want it installed fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl ðɛm wi wɑnt ɪt ɪnˈstɔld fæst./
dialogue.zh: 跟他們說我們想盡快安裝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, my name is Daniel Brooks.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我叫丹尼爾·布魯克斯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask about plans for a small home.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk əˈbaʊt plænz fər ə smɔl hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 問問適合小家庭的套餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says he can help with that today.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛz hi kæn hɛlp wɪð ðæt təˈdeɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, ask about the price first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What plans do you have available?
dialogue.zh: 你們有哪些可用的套餐？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write down the numbers, don't forget.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He lists three plans, basic to fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi lɪsts θri plænz, ˈbeɪsɪk tu fæst./
dialogue.zh: 他列了三種套餐，從基本到高速。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much is the basic one?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one costs thirty a month.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the middle plan? Ask him.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The middle one costs fifty a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɪdəl wʌn kɔsts ˈfɪfti ə mʌnθ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does that include the router too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the router comes with it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What about the fastest plan?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The top plan costs seventy-five.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That seems expensive for us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says it's best for streaming video.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛz ɪts bɛst fər ˈstrimin ˈvɪdioʊ./
dialogue.zh: 他說這個最適合看串流影片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We stream shows every night, remember?
dialogue.zh: 我們每晚都追劇，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True, we watch a lot of shows.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru, wi wɑtʃ ə lɑt əv ʃoʊz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How fast is the middle plan?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It runs at two hundred megabits.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that fast enough for two screens?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt fæst ɪˈnʌf fər tu skrinz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says yes, it runs two screens.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛz jɛs, ɪt rʌnz tu skrinz./
dialogue.zh: 他說可以，撐得住兩塊螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the middle plan sounds good.
dialogue.zh: 那聽起來中間套餐不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll tell him we choose that.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪl tɛl hɪm wi tʃuz ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 好，我告訴他我們選這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask if there are any hidden fees.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ɪf ðɛr ɑr ˈɛni ˈhɪdən fiz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there extra charges each month?
dialogue.zh: 每月有其他額外收費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen carefully to his answer now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a small equipment fee only.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much is that equipment fee?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's five dollars for the modem.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's fair, the modem is theirs.
dialogue.zh: 很合理，數據機是他們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He also mentions an installation charge.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much for installing it here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's ninety, or free with signing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free sounds much better to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The free option needs a twelve-month term.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fri ˈɑpʃən nidz ə twɛlv mʌnθ tərm./
dialogue.zh: 免費選項要綁滿十二個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One year is fine, we'll stay here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn jɪr ɪz faɪn, wil steɪ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 一年沒問題，我們會住這。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if we move before one year?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf wi muv bɪˈfɔr wʌn jɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 如果一年內搬家怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask about the early cancel fee.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a fee for canceling early?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə fi fər ˈkænsəlɪŋ ˈɜrli?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He should give us the real number.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ʃʊd ɡiv ʌs ðə ril ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 他應該給我們確切的數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The early fee is half a month's cost.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɜrli fi ɪz hæf ə mʌnθs kɔst./
dialogue.zh: 違約金是半個月的費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honestly, that's not too bad.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we keep the same phone number?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi kip ðə seɪm foʊn ˈnʌmbər?/
dialogue.zh: 我們能保留原本的電話號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our home phone is with that number.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊr hoʊm foʊn ɪz wɪð ðæt ˈnʌmbər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says yes, keeping it is easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛz jɛs, ˈkipɪŋ ɪt ɪz ˈizi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful, I hate changing numbers.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我最討厭換號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, one more thing for us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask him if we get email too.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɪm ɪf wi ɡɛt ˈimeɪl tu./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you provide email with internet?
dialogue.zh: 你們的網路會附信箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll want two separate mailboxes.
dialogue.zh: 我們要兩個獨立的信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two accounts are fine, he says.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, we're done with questions?
dialogue.zh: 太好了，問題都問完了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost — I must ask about data caps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlˌmoʊst, aɪ mʌst æsk əˈbaʊt ˈdeɪtə kæps./
dialogue.zh: 快問完了——我還得問流量上限。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is there a limit each month?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a monthly data limit?
dialogue.zh: 有每個月的流量限制嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says it's unlimited, no caps.
dialogue.zh: 他說無限流量，沒有上限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's our plan then, the middle one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts aʊr plæn ðɛn, ðə ˈmɪdəl wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell him we want the one-year deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɪm wi wɑnt ðə wʌn jɪr dil./
dialogue.zh: 告訴他我們要一年優惠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll take the deal, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask when someone can come out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can a technician visit us?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This week or next, we decide.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soonest is best, my patience is gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsunəst ɪz bɛst, maɪ ˈpeɪʃəns ɪz ɡɑn./
dialogue.zh: 越快越好，我忍不下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday morning if we're free?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have a meeting early Friday.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then ask for after twelve noon.
dialogue.zh: 那就約中午十二點以後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we have Friday afternoon, please?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He's checking the schedule right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He asked us to hold a moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi æskt ʌs tə hoʊld ə ˈmoʊmənt./
dialogue.zh: 他請我們別掛斷，稍等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, I'll wait right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday two to four is open.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Book it, book it right away!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That works, please put us down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask him to say it all back.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɪm tə seɪ ɪt ɔl bæk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So: Friday, two to four, yes?
dialogue.zh: 所以是週五兩到四點，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the address is correct?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our address is 22 Maple Avenue.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊr əˈdrɛs ɪz ˈtwɛnti tu ˈmeɪpəl ˈævəˌnjuː./
dialogue.zh: 我們的地址是楓香大道22號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it slowly, let him write.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He repeated the whole address fine.
dialogue.zh: 他把地址完整覆核了一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What do we do now, wait?
dialogue.zh: 那我們現在做什麼，等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He'll text a confirmation today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask him about our old router.
dialogue.zh: 問問舊路由器怎麼處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we keep our old router?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He said no, theirs works better.
dialogue.zh: 他說不用，他們那台更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that confirmation text arrive yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it just buzzed in my pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt dʒʌst bʌzd ɪn maɪ ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 到了，剛剛在我口袋裡震了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read it aloud, I can't see well.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt əˈlaʊd, aɪ kænt si wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 唸出來給我聽，我看不太清。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says Friday, two to four.
dialogue.zh: 上面寫週五，兩點到四點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Also a technician's name?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His name is Mark, from the company.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz neɪm ɪz mɑrk, frʌm ðə ˈkʌmpəni./
dialogue.zh: 他叫馬克，是公司的師傅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will he call before coming?
dialogue.zh: 他來之前會先打電話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The text says he'll call first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, now we need to prepare.
dialogue.zh: 好，那我們得先準備一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Prepare what? Just open the door.
dialogue.zh: 準備什麼？開門就好了呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, he needs space for his tools.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, hi nidz speɪs fər hɪz tuːlz./
dialogue.zh: 不，他需要放工具的空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can clear the small table then.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn klɪr ðə smɔl ˈteɪbəl ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那我們把小桌子清乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And where should the router go?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The living room gets the best signal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ rum ɡɛts ðə bɛst ˈsɪɡnəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that shelf high enough for it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ʃɛlf haɪ ɪˈnʌf fər ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, wifi travels better up high.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we move the fish tank away?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi muːv ðə fɪʃ tæŋk əˈweɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water blocks the signal, so yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I didn't know that about water!
dialogue.zh: 我都不知道水還有這影響！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, the shelf is clear now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the cables on the floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈkeɪbəlz ɑn ðə flɔr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuck them away, avoid tripping him.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have spare batteries anywhere?
dialogue.zh: 我們哪裡有備用電池嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why batteries? He brings his own tools.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ˈbætəriz? hi brɪŋz hɪz oʊn tuːlz./
dialogue.zh: 要電池幹嘛？他自帶工具。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh right, the drill thing, of course.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ raɪt, ðə drɪl θɪŋ, ʌv kɔrs./
dialogue.zh: 喔對，是要鑽牆那件事，當然。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Will he make a lot of dust?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl hi meɪk ə lɑt əv dʌst?/
dialogue.zh: 他會弄得到處是灰塵嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe, so cover the couch first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll find an old sheet for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl faɪnd ən oʊld ʃit fər ðæt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, do we need our ID ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ, du wi nid ˈaʊər aɪˈdi ˈrɛdi?/
dialogue.zh: 還有，我們要把證件備好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The text says bring one photo ID.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɛkst sɛz brɪŋ wʌn ˈfoʊtoʊ aɪˈdi./
dialogue.zh: 簡訊說備一個有照片的證件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My driver's license will do fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And mine, for the second account.
dialogue.zh: 還有我的，第二個帳號用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did they ask for the lease too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðeɪ æsk fər ðə lis tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just the landlord's okay by text.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, dʒʌst ðə ˈlændˌlɔrdz oʊˈkeɪ baɪ tɛkst./
dialogue.zh: 不用，房東傳訊息同意就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I already sent him the request.
dialogue.zh: 我已經把請求發給他了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He replied, the landlord says yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One worry: the parking downstairs.
dialogue.zh: 一個煩惱：樓下的停車位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His van needs a close spot, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz væn nidz ə kloʊz spɑt, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 他的工作車要停在附近，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, heavy equipment, short walk.
dialogue.zh: 對，設備很重，路要盡量短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reserve the visitor space for Friday.
dialogue.zh: 先把週五的來賓車位保留。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll put a chair there to save it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl pʊt ə tʃɛr ðɛr tə seɪv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我放把椅子在那裡先卡位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The office can save it for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɔfəs kæn seɪv ɪt fər ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 可以請管理處正式留位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we feed the technician lunch?
dialogue.zh: 我們要請師傅吃午餐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He arrives at two, lunch is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi əˈraɪvz æt tu, lʌntʃ ɪz dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 他兩點來，午餐早吃完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Offer him water, that's polite.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thought, I'll chill a bottle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if he comes while we're out?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf hi kʌmz waɪl wɪr aʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 如果他來的時候我們不在家？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then nobody opens the gate below.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We must stay home Friday afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 週五下午我們一定待在家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll move my gym class that day.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl muːv maɪ dʒɪm klæs ðæt deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我把那天的健身課挪走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And cancel the cleaning service too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already done, they'll come Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 早就辦好了，他們改週六來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the dogs behave for him?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's keep them in my room then.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts kip ðɛm ɪn maɪ rum ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那到時把牠們關進我房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They whine at the closed door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give them bones, they'll be quiet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You always know the dog tricks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve years of raising puppies, dear.
dialogue.zh: 我養了十二年小狗呀，親愛的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the visitor chair working there?
dialogue.zh: 那把椅子放在車位那裡行嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move it, the landlord complained already.
dialogue.zh: 搬開吧，房東已經抱怨了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, I'll call the front desk now.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn, aɪl kɔl ðə frʌnt dɛsk naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask them to note it for Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ðɛm tə noʊt ɪt fər ˈfraɪˌdeɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They'll save space two for us.
dialogue.zh: 他們會幫我們留2號車位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that worry is gone now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we still pay by card monthly?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi stɪl peɪ baɪ kɑrd ˈmʌnθli?/
dialogue.zh: 我們還是每月刷信用卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He offered autopay, remember that?
dialogue.zh: 他提過自動扣款，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, five dollars off every month.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So sign up for the autopay plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ saɪn ʌp fər ði ˈɔltoʊˌpeɪ plæn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll do it tonight on the site.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl du ɪt təˈnaɪt ɑn ðə saɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Their site is slow after ten, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr saɪt ɪz sloʊ ˈæftər tɛn, ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不過他們的網站十點後很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'll try in the morning break.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪl traɪ ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ breɪk./
dialogue.zh: 那我早上休息時間試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Is the old modem boxed up?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt. ɪz ði oʊld ˈmodɛm bɑkst ʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。舊數據機收進箱子了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not yet, the cables are tangled.
dialogue.zh: 還沒，線全都纏在一起了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wrap them loosely, don't pull hard.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we return that box to them?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi rɪˈtɜrn ðæt bɑks tu ðɛm?/
dialogue.zh: 那個機盒要還給他們嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He said keep it for the exchange.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛd kip ɪt fər ði ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ./
dialogue.zh: 他說先留著，之後換新機要用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, are we exchanging the phone?
dialogue.zh: 等等，我們的電話也要換？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the landline stays the same.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the kids' school calls it.
dialogue.zh: 好，小孩的學校都打那號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The internet switch won't touch it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday is soon. I feel ready now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪˌdeɪ ɪz sun. aɪ fil ˈrɛdi naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 週五馬上就到了，我現在覺得準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost — did you test the doorbell?
dialogue.zh: 差不多了——門鈴測過了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The doorbell is dead, no wait, what now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɔrˌbɛl ɪz dɛd, noʊ weɪt, wʌt naʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll hear his knock, the wall is thin.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil hɪr hɪz nɑk, ðə wɔl ɪz θɪn./
dialogue.zh: 他敲門我們聽得見，牆很薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or he texts, and I run down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr hi tɛksts, ænd aɪ rʌn daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 或是他傳訊息，我就跑下樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's keep our ringtones loud then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should we ask him on Friday?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ʃʊd wi æsk hɪm ɑn ˈfraɪˌdeɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which corner has the best wifi?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And how to fix small problems.
dialogue.zh: 還有小故障怎麼自己處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He'll teach us, they're usually friendly.
dialogue.zh: 他會教的，他們通常都很親切。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, show him the dead bedroom spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ, ʃoʊ hɪm ðə dɛd ˈbɛdˌrum spɑt./
dialogue.zh: 還有，帶他看臥室死角那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Ask if a booster helps there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs! æsk ɪf ə ˈbusˌtər hɛlps ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 對！問問加訊號器有沒有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the living room looks nice.
dialogue.zh: 現在客廳看起來像樣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coats off the chair, done at last.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊts ɔf ðə tʃɛr, dʌn æt læst./
dialogue.zh: 外套從椅子上拿掉，終於好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's make a checklist for Friday.
dialogue.zh: 我們來為週五列張檢查清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, you talk, I'll write.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: ID, order number, phone charged up.
dialogue.zh: 證件、訂單編號、手機充飽電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water chilled, dogs inside, done.
dialogue.zh: 水冰好了，狗關好了，齊全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday can't come fast enough for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪˌdeɪ kænt kʌm fæst ɪˈnʌf fər mi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here — no wifi movies tonight!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello, Mark from the internet company.
dialogue.zh: 您好，我是網路公司的馬克。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hi Mark! Come in, we're ready.
dialogue.zh: 嗨馬克！請進，我們準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks! Shoes off, is that okay?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, here are slippers by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, hɪr ɑr ˈslɪpərz baɪ ðə dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You two are Daniel and Kate?
dialogue.zh: 兩位是丹尼爾和凱特吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's us! May I see your badge?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ʌs! meɪ aɪ si jʊr bædʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 是我們！能看下你的證件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, here's my work ID.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. The table is clear for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt. ðə ˈteɪbəl ɪz klɪr fər ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, where is the wall jack?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Behind the sofa — I pulled it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈsoʊfə, aɪ pʊld ɪt aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 沙發後面，我已經拉出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I can reach it easily now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, aɪ kæn ritʃ ɪt ˈizəli naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you need more light over there?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid mɔr laɪt ˈoʊvər ðɛr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, it's bright enough, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can we start with the outside line?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi stɑrt wɪð ði ˈaʊtˌsaɪd laɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 可以先從戶外那段著手嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I'll check the outside box first.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪl tʃɛk ði ˈaʊtˌsaɪd bɑks fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 好，我先去看戶外的接盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's out on the balcony, near the rail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts aʊt ɑn ðə ˈbælkəni, nɪr ðə reɪl./
dialogue.zh: 在陽台上，就在欄杆旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll grab the fiber from my van.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ɡræb ðə ˈfaɪbər frʌm maɪ væn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Need help carrying anything heavy?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just light, but thank you all the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst laɪt, bʌt θæŋk ju ɔl ðə seɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does the small table work for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə smɔl ˈteɪbəl wɜrk fər ju?/
dialogue.zh: 小桌子放你的工具包行嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, perfect height for my tools.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long will the wiring take?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, then the setup.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can the kids watch? They're curious.
dialogue.zh: 小孩可以看嗎？他們很好奇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, just no touching the tools.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says yes, kids, hands behind backs!
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛz jɛs, kɪdz, hændz bɪˈhaɪnd bæks!/
dialogue.zh: 他說行，孩子們，手放背後！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This here is the new fiber cable.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs hɪr ɪz ðə nju ˈfaɪbər ˈkeɪbəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks too thin to do much!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lʊks tu θɪn tə du mʌtʃ!/
dialogue.zh: 看起來這麼細，真的行嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thin, but the speed inside is fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪn, bʌt ðə spid ɪnˈsaɪd ɪz fæst./
dialogue.zh: 細是細，裡面的速度飛快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glad we left it to a pro.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlæd wi lɛft ɪt tə ə proʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch how I clip this to the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ haʊ aɪ klɪp ðɪs tə ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 看我把卡扣固定到牆上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, no drilling at all today!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small clips, your walls stay safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The landlord will really like that.
dialogue.zh: 房東一定會很滿意這點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you want this box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tall shelf, up high, near the sofa.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɔl ʃɛlf, ʌp haɪ, nɪr ðə ˈsoʊfə./
dialogue.zh: 書架上，挑高那一層，靠沙發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good choice for whole-home wifi.
dialogue.zh: 這個位置覆蓋全屋剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that the modem or the router?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ðə ˈmodɛm ɔr ðə ˈraʊtər?/
dialogue.zh: 那個是數據機還是路由器？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is the modem; router's next.
dialogue.zh: 這是數據機，下一個是路由器。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They look almost the same to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ lʊk ˈɔlˌmoʊst ðə seɪm tə mi./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Modem talks to street, router talks home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmodɛm tɔks tə strit, ˈraʊtər tɔks hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 數據機對外連，路由器對內連。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a simple way to remember.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, now the power cable.
dialogue.zh: 等一下，現在來接電源線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two lights are blinking already!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue means connecting, give it a moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu minz kənˈɛktɪŋ, ɡiv ɪt ə ˈmoʊmənt./
dialogue.zh: 藍色代表連線中，稍等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The neighbor's cat sniffs at your bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈneɪbərz kæt snɪfs æt jʊr bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 鄰居的貓正在聞你的工具包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh hi, little guy! Nothing dangerous.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，小傢伙！沒有危險東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He always makes friends with workers.
dialogue.zh: 牠見了工人都能變朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steady blue — we're online, look!
dialogue.zh: 藍燈恆亮了——連上網了，看！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So fast! We didn't wait long.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let's set your network name.
dialogue.zh: 現在來設定你們的網路名稱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We already picked one last night.
dialogue.zh: 我們昨晚就想好一個了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great — what should it be?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tater Tot Express, the kids chose it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈteɪtər tɑt ɪkˈsprɛs, ðə kɪdz tʃoz ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fun name, typing it in now.
dialogue.zh: 有趣的名字，我現在打進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the password is on paper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, that avoids any typos.
dialogue.zh: 正好，這樣就不會打錯字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that password strong enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It has both letters and numbers.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And it has eight characters total.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done! Scan this code with phones.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which phone should we try first?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yours, Daniel — open your wifi list.
dialogue.zh: 你的那支，丹尼爾——開WiFi列表。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see Tater Tot right there!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap it, enter the password.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Connected! The whole thing took seconds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's try the laptop next, same steps.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts traɪ ðə ˈlæpˌtɑp nɛkst, seɪm stɛps./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It joined by itself, look at that!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʒɔɪnd baɪ ɪtˈsɛlf, lʊk æt ðæt!/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saved ones join again by themselves.
dialogue.zh: 存過的網路會自己重連。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice. What about the smart TV?
dialogue.zh: 不錯。那智慧電視怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plug this short cable behind it.
dialogue.zh: 把這根短線插到電視後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That port was so hard to find.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt pɔrt wʌz soʊ hɑrd tə faɪnd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: HDMI, always the tricky one.
dialogue.zh: 高畫質接口，永遠最難搞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The TV is online now too!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's check every room for signal.
dialogue.zh: 我們每個房間測一下訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bedroom corner was our dead spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbɛdˌrum ˈkɔrnər wʌz ˈaʊər dɛd spɑt./
dialogue.zh: 臥室角落以前完全收不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walking there now... how many bars?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only one bar, that's not good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: As expected. I'll fetch the booster.
dialogue.zh: 果然如此。我去拿增強器。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You brought one after all, genius!
dialogue.zh: 你果真帶了一台，太神了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plug it in the hallway outlet.
dialogue.zh: 把它插在走廊的插座上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the bedroom shows three bars!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Full strength, and the kitchen too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This man is a wifi wizard.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost done, one more quick test.
dialogue.zh: 快收尾了，最後快測一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should we open a video together?
dialogue.zh: 我們要一起開個影片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, pick your highest quality show.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No buffering at all. Unbelievable!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The old lines couldn't do that.
dialogue.zh: 以前的老線根本做不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the download test looks great.
dialogue.zh: 下載測試看起來也很漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's download a big game file.
dialogue.zh: 來下載一個大的遊戲檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done in ten seconds? Ridiculous, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hundred megabits, right on target.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our calls will never freeze again.
dialogue.zh: 視訊再也卡不動我們了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One form to sign, if you please.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn fɔrm tə saɪn, ɪf ju pliz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where exactly do I write my name?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪɡˈzæktli du aɪ raɪt maɪ neɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, sign right by the speed line.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, saɪn raɪt baɪ ðə spid laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 這裡，就在速率那行旁邊簽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says two hundred — that's right!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're all set. Anything else today?
dialogue.zh: 全部搞定。今天還有別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes — Mark, take a photo with the kids!
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, mɑrk, teɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ wɪð ðə kɪdz!/
dialogue.zh: 好──馬克，跟孩子們拍張合照吧！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mark, do you need the old modem?
dialogue.phonetic: /mɑrk, du ju nid ði oʊld ˈmodɛm?/
dialogue.zh: 馬克，舊數據機你要帶走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we recycle the old ones.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is any data stored inside it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only settings, no personal files.
dialogue.zh: 只有設定值，沒有個人資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then take it, it's all yours.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll give you a receipt for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ɡiv ju ə rɪˈsit fər ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我會給你一張歸還收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why a receipt for giving stuff?
dialogue.zh: 交還東西怎麼還要收據？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Proof you returned it, protects you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's actually very smart.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sign here that today's work is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪn hɪr ðæt təˈdeɪz wɜrk ɪz dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡簽今天安裝完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Date it the second of May?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today's date, please, and one signature.
dialogue.zh: 寫今天的日期，簽一個名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. And the paper contract?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It mails tonight, or check online.
dialogue.zh: 今晚會寄出，也能線上查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The speed test printout, please?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's the results page, keep it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two-seventy? That's above plan!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I promise you'll love the speed.
dialogue.zh: 我保證你會愛上這速度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the router rent, Mark?
dialogue.zh: 那路由器的租金呢，馬克？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The plan includes it, no extra fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə plæn ɪnˈkludz ɪt, noʊ ˈɛkstrə fi./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If we upgrade later, keep this one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf wi ˈʌpˌɡreɪd ˈleɪtər, kip ðɪs wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 如果以後升級，這台還留得住？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New plan, new router, free swap.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if this router breaks soon?
dialogue.zh: 萬一這台很快壞了怎辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call us, we replace it, no cost.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl ʌs, wi rɪˈpleɪs ɪt, noʊ kɔst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a warranty on cables?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One year, same as the contract.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When does the first bill come?
dialogue.zh: 第一期帳單什麼時候來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next week, with today's service on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst wiːk, wɪð təˈdeɪz ˈsɜrvɪs ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 下週，會列上今天的服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will today's booster show up there?
dialogue.zh: 今天買的增強器會列進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, forty dollars, one time only.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the install fee really zero?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Zero, since you signed one year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I see the full bill?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn aɪ si ðə fʊl bɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 我在哪裡能看到完整帳單？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Log in, then tap the billing tab.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑɡ ɪn, ðɛn tæp ðə ˈbɪlɪŋ tæb./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can paper bills still be sent?
dialogue.zh: 還能寄紙本帳單給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, two dollars extra monthly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Email is fine, thanks anyway.
dialogue.zh: 電子帳單就好，仍謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your total stays under eighty, good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who do we call about charges?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the number printed on your bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ðə ˈnʌmbər ˈprɪntɪd ɑn jʊr bɪl./
dialogue.zh: 就是帳單上印的那支號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that line different from sales?
dialogue.zh: 那條線跟業務專線不同嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, billing has its own team.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What hours will they answer?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine to nine, every single day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, that's all my questions.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我想問的都問完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you! You're officially online.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, one more thing about support.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The help chat lives in our app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɛlp tʃæt lɪvz ɪn aʊr æp./
dialogue.zh: 線上客服就在我們的APP裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are evening calls charged at all?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No fees ever, it's always free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Any tips for good wifi?
dialogue.zh: 完美。有沒有保持訊號的訣竅？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Restart the router once weekly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just unplug and plug back?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ten seconds off, that's all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if the lights turn red?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call our line, don't panic, friend.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You seem sure we won't call.
dialogue.zh: 你看來很確定我們用不上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fiber rarely fails, trust me here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We saved your card and number, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi seɪvd jʊr kɑrd ænd ˈnʌmbər, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 你的名片和專線我們存好了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You've got my direct line now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We really appreciate your work.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was fun, your family's great.
dialogue.zh: 我也很快樂，你家人超棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tips are allowed, right, Kate?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, company rules say no tips!
dialogue.zh: 啊，公司規定不能收小費！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then take this coffee, at least.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You two are too kind, thanks!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It even works in the bathroom!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That booster is magic, bye, all!
dialogue.zh: 那台增強器就是魔法，再見！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So... tonight we watch everything.
dialogue.zh: 那……今晚我們要全部看完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole list we saved for months.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl lɪst wi seɪvd fər mʌnθs./
dialogue.zh: 那份存了好幾個月的追劇清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, let me check the bill site.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst, lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə bɪl saɪt./
dialogue.zh: 先讓我看一下帳單頁面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is anything already there for us?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a deposit, one small thing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deposit? Nobody mentioned a deposit!
dialogue.zh: 押金？沒人說過押金這事！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me read the small print.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says: returned after six months.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that's actually fair enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take a screenshot, just in case.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Where is the autopay button?
dialogue.zh: 設好了。自動扣款按鈕在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Billing settings, then payment method.
dialogue.zh: 帳單設定，再選繳費方式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Choose the card ending forty-two?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the cheap one, pick it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set! A confirmation popped up.
dialogue.zh: 設定成功！跳出了確認頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save that too, we may need proof.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ðæt tu, wi meɪ nid pruf./
dialogue.zh: 這個也存著，可能要憑證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When will they charge this card?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The third of every month, it says.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə θɜrd əv ˈɛvri mʌnθ, ɪt sɛz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better put that in my notes.
dialogue.zh: 這個最好記進我的筆記。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The monthly total looks very clear.
dialogue.zh: 每月總額列得一清二楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we change plans later, though?
dialogue.zh: 不過以後還能換套餐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You get one free switch per year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡɛt wʌn fri swɪtʃ pɜr jɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if we need an upgrade?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call first, members get better rates.
dialogue.zh: 先打來，老會員費率更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me test one last thing now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tɛst wʌn læst θɪŋ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我現在測最後一樣東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A video call with grandma tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ring ring... she picks up instantly!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her face is so sharp, look!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Installing internet was this easy?
dialogue.zh: 裝寬頻原來可以這麼輕鬆？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We did great, if I may say that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi dɪd ɡreɪt, ɪf aɪ meɪ seɪ ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 我們表現超好，容我自誇一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Movie night on our brand-new wifi!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmuvi naɪt ɑn aʊr brænd nju ˈwaɪfaɪ!/
dialogue.zh: 在我們的全新WiFi上辦電影夜！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Popcorn is ready, wifi is ready.
